scope: Pixel-level comparison of the user's small GTK2 scrollbar attachment against the measured normal-state Domain/OS SR10.4 HP VUE 2.01 Motif vertical scrollbar crop. No source changes or GUI input.

gtk2_attachment.note: Only the scrollbar region was sampled; no text/pixel crop was copied into project records.

context_attachment.note: Used to orient the narrow scrollbar crop; no content was transcribed.

method: Compared 1:1 pixel coordinates and cross-axis profiles from the supplied 102x655 crop with the project's native VUE crop. The face-role-only color substitution is reported separately from geometric/relief differences; no palette RGB was proposed as a product constant.

geometry.result: Width matches the native metric. The cropped context is insufficient to separate the content frame from the 4px view-to-bar gap.

upper_arrow.result: Arrow mask, placement, dark and light relief match. The 61 raw RGB differences are the face role only.

lower_arrow.remaining_difference: 11 pixels in the first cell row: GTK2 face where VUE has the measured dark/light leading-edge pattern.
lower_arrow.result: The triangle body aligns, but the cell's first horizontal relief row differs; do not describe this as a glyph-size mismatch.

trough_cross_section.result: The R731 flatter adaptation is present in the long non-thumb trough; it removes the four inner bevel pixels per cross-section measured in VUE.

thumb_cross_section.result: The raised thumb profile matches in this sample. Its visible length is content-dependent and cannot be judged against the nearly-full thumb in the empty Trash Can.

comparison.interaction_state: The screenshot is a single static view. It does not prove pressed, hover, disabled, or scrolling behavior.

result: The attachment confirms the 15px GTK2 bar width and distinguishes the raised thumb from the flatter trough. Three differences are visible against the native reference: the face role is brighter in this active GTK palette; the lower arrow cell lacks the first-row relief pattern; and the trough lacks the four measured inner relief pixels. The upper arrow's shape/relief otherwise matches after separating the dynamic face color.
next: Keep GTK2 as the active family. Record this as a new comparison, but do not alter the theme until the user reviews these separated differences. Pressed/disabled VUE input and thumb drag remain separately gated by I517/I518.
correction: R738 inverted the two user attachments: the narrow image is the Motif reference and the large image is GTK2. Its GTK2 trough-profile conclusions must not be used.
